title: 第5章 斩苏云第6章 斩草除根
slug: 长生家族从十七岁成为家主开始
lines: “怎么，藏了这么久了，还不肯现身吗？”
李行歌的话音才落地，一道人影便如闪电一般从人群中飞速窜出，向着谷外狂奔而去。
这个人影，不是别人，正是一直潜伏在暗中等待时机的苏家大长老，苏云。
作为半只脚踏入了气血境的修士，无限接近气血境的存在，苏云的感知力自然要远远超过邹家家主这些人。
邹家家主只是猜测李行歌是气血境，并不确定。
但苏云心中却非常清楚，李行歌已经是货真价实的气血境修士了。
有可能是因为刚刚突破气血境的关系，李行歌还不能够完美的收敛自身的气息，被苏云给察觉到了。
出身于气血境家族莽山苏氏的他，比谁都明白，气血境修士的可怕之处。
气血境之下，皆为蝼蚁。
这句话可不是开玩笑的。
两者之间已经不是同一个生命层次。
在察觉到李行歌是气血境修士后，几乎是没有任何犹豫，苏云便准备逃离李家。
至于邹家家主等人，那便只能自求多福了。
同时，他的心中也是无比震撼。
苏家作为李家的老对手，他自然比谁都清楚李家的情况。
李家又有了新的气血境修士，不可怕。
可怕的是这位气血境修士，才十七岁。
这等天资，恐怕是先天境界也大有希望。
纵观白河县数百年历史，都从未有过如此妖孽之人。
为何这等妖孽不是他苏家的人。
想到这，苏云不禁头皮发麻，为苏家的未来感到着急。
以他苏家和李家这上百年来结下的仇怨，若是李行歌未来真的突破到了先天境，苏家怕是要第一个被其灭族。
“不行，绝对不能坐以待毙，待我回到族中，定要说服老祖，不惜一切代价，将李行歌斩杀，以绝后患！”
苏云心中暗自咬牙。
看到飞速遁走的那道狼狈人影。
李行歌脸上泛起一丝冷意，他冷笑一声，开口道：“阁下当我李家是什么地方？想来就来，想走就走？”
身后传来的冰冷声音让苏云身子一抖。
他没有回头理会，速度反而愈发加快，只要他能逃回苏家，得到老祖的庇护，那他就安全了。
李行歌就算再强，也不敢去苏家找他的麻烦。
“真以为你能从我眼皮子底下逃走吗？”
李行歌冷笑一声，双手结了一个古老晦涩的手印。
周身，沸腾的气血之力蒸腾而出。
李行歌对着虚空一握，磅礴的气血之力幻化成一张巨大的弓。
李行歌抓住这弓，张弓搭箭，箭尖直指苏云。
当蓄力到极致。
content_en:
"Why, you've been hiding for so long and you still refuse to show up?"
...
As soon as Li Xingge finished speaking, a figure sprang out of the crowd like lightning and ran wildly out of the valley.
This figure is none other than Su family's eldest elder, Su Yun, who has been lurking in the dark waiting for the opportunity.
As a monk who has half a foot in the Qi and Blood Realm, and is infinitely close to the Qi and Blood Realm, Su Yun's perception is naturally far greater than that of the head of the Zou family.
The head of the Zou family only guessed that Li Xingge was in the Qi and Blood realm, but was not sure.
But Su Yun knew very well that Li Xingge was already a genuine Qi and Blood Realm monk.
It may be that because he had just broken through the Qi and Blood realm, Li Xingge was still unable to perfectly control his aura, and Su Yun noticed it.
Born in the Mangshan Su family of the Qi and Blood Realm family, he understands better than anyone else the terrifying aspects of the Qi and Blood Realm monks.
Under the Qi and Blood realm, everyone is an ant.
This statement is no joke.
The two are no longer at the same level of life.
After realizing that Li Xingge was a monk in the Qi and Blood Realm, Su Yun prepared to escape from the Li family without any hesitation.
As for the head of the Zou family and others, they can only ask for their own blessings.
At the same time, he was extremely shocked.
As the Su family's old rival, he naturally knows the Li family's situation better than anyone else.
The Li family has a new Qi and Blood Realm monk, who is not scary.
The scary thing is that this Qi and Blood Realm monk is only seventeen years old.
With this kind of talent, I am afraid that there is great hope for the innate realm.
Throughout the hundreds of years of history of Baihe County, there has never been such a monster.
Why are these monsters not from his Su family?
Thinking of this, Su Yun couldn't help but feel numb and worried about the future of the Su family.
Based on the feud between his Su family and Li family for hundreds of years, if Li Xingge really breaks through to the Xiantian realm in the future, the Su family may be the first to be exterminated by him.
"No, I absolutely cannot sit back and wait for death. When I return to the clan, I must convince my ancestor to kill Li Xingge at all costs to avoid future troubles!"
Su Yun gritted his teeth secretly in his heart.
I saw the embarrassed figure running away quickly.
There was a hint of coldness on Li Xingge's face. He sneered and said, "What kind of place do you think my Li family is? Can I come here whenever I want and leave whenever I want?"
The cold voice coming from behind made Su Yun tremble.
He didn't look back, and instead speeded up. As long as he could escape back to the Su family and get the protection of his ancestor, he would be safe.
No matter how strong Li Xingge was, he would not dare to go to the Su family to cause trouble for him.
"Do you really think you can escape from under my nose?"
Li Xingge sneered and formed an ancient and obscure mudra with his hands.
All over his body, the power of boiling Qi and blood steamed out.
Li Xingge held his hand in the void, and the majestic power of Qi and blood transformed into a huge bow.
Li Xingge grabbed the bow, opened the bow and nocked an arrow, pointing directly at Su Yun.
When the energy is accumulated to the extreme.
"Whoosh"
